verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Lovable projects produce editable full-stack codebases that can be downloaded directly or synced to GitHub/GitLab, worked on locally in an IDE, and deployed outside Lovable (self-hosting implied). This covers export and running outside the platform, though the backend relies on Lovable Cloud/Supabase integration which may need replication elsewhere. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of a fully self-hosted deployment without any Lovable Cloud dependency, and detail on migrating the backend/database itself.
